deep-space-navigator.specific_finding: The summary says ships can stop or reverse by applying opposite thrust over multiple turns. TonyWatson’s contemporary feature (SpaceGamer67 January/February1984 printed4/PDF6) explicitly states a minimum speed of one, maximum of eight, and that backwards movement is ruled out. It illustrates that a ship moving at speed one cannot apply four units of reverse maneuver to travel three units in the opposite direction. The summary therefore teaches illegal stopping and reversing under the covered original1983rules. The same page permits combat before or after movement at the player’s option, rather than the summary’s fixed post-navigation combat sequence. Specific MAJOR for these covered movement/timing rules only; the original changes sheet has unresolved shield ambiguity and later revised-edition equivalence remains unproven. No full audit or summary body repair.

colony-delta.specific_finding: The summary gives automatic resource income from controlled territories and presents control of most territory or elimination as the win condition. Hackett’s contemporary reference (Phoenix30 March/April1981 printed20–21/PDF24–25) instead says the primary aim is economic VP production: colonist/worker units must mine ore deposits, normally producing one OrePoint per unit per turn or five for a permanent colony. Ore must reach a Spaceport and then the home planet before it earns VPs; ore left on Delta at game end is worthless. Farming generates home-planet VPs directly, and mining and farming cannot coexist in a hex. The printed28/PDF32 turn table places economic collection after military actions and includes distinct surface and space transport. Replacing these production/transport decisions with generic territory income and a military-control objective changes the core game. Specific MAJOR against covered economic rules only; full ending/tie conditions and numerical CRT/units remain uncertified. The source’s air-return/advance ordering conflict is unresolved, and reviewer house rules are excluded. No full audit or summary body repair.
